# Append To Array

Source: [wiki article 4565](../archive/4565.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Append To Array](../../api/values/append-to-array.md).

<a id="wiki-4565-n1"></a>

- Append To Array value returns a copy, unlike the variable-modification operation of the same name.

<a id="wiki-4565-n2"></a>

- Appending an array appends each of its elements rather than inserting that array as one nested item.
